quality_contract.name: Prototype
quality_contract.purpose: Test one highest-risk assumption with the smallest reversible artifact.

rules.rule: One primary path, fixtures, stubs and mocks are allowed when declared.
Configured static diagnostics may not be skipped or hidden.
Prototype evidence may not be presented as production readiness.
Record at least one target signal and the known limitations.
The named risky assumption is answered by observable evidence.
The artifact can be inspected or run inside the declared boundary.

escalations.escalation: Escalate only an owner decision or a blocked target signal.

quality_contract.name: MVP
quality_contract.purpose: Deliver one complete relevant user scenario with deterministic evidence.

rules.rule: Secondary paths, polish and scale work may remain explicit follow-up work.
Relevant newly created behavior may not ship without dedicated tests.
Known limitations and skipped coverage may not be omitted.
Record the scenario result, gate results and remaining owner acceptance.
One relevant end-to-end user scenario works inside the accepted scope.
All applicable static checks, dedicated tests and document lint are green.

escalations.escalation: Use an independent reviewer for high-risk work.
Use an independent reviewer after a correction cycle.
Review data, access, external contracts and cross-project boundaries.

quality_contract.name: Production
quality_contract.purpose: Prepare and verify a real release and deployment with rollback boundaries.

rules.rule: Only explicitly accepted non-blocking limitations are allowed.
Deployment or publication may not occur without recorded owner approval.
Applicable MVP checks and release checks may not be reduced.
Record revision, target, checks, deployment verification and rollback evidence.
The exact release is built, deployed and verified in the authorized target.
Rollback, observability, compatibility and data-safety boundaries are explicit.

escalations.escalation: Production always requires an independent reviewer after green gates.
Deployment, publication and irreversible actions require owner approval.

quality_contract.name: Security audit
quality_contract.purpose: Perform a read-only scoped security assessment and report residual risk.

rules.rule: Coverage limits are allowed only when reported as limits.
The audit may not modify the target unless a separate change is authorized.
Missing security coverage is unavailable, never passed.
Record scoped findings, evidence references and residual risk.
Assets, trust boundaries, threat model and coverage are explicit.
Findings include severity, evidence, mitigation and residual risk.

escalations.escalation: A designated security reviewer is mandatory.
Remediation is a separate authorized workflow.
